key.name: lockscreen-mode
key.description: Visual style of the lock screen. WACK is the classic GNOME-compliant mode; Cupertino emulates macOS Sonoma style.

key.name: cupertino-always-show-user
key.summary: Always show user widget in Cupertino mode
key.description: If true, the user widget is always shown in Cupertino mode. Notifications are hidden by default but can be toggled by pressing Shift+N.

key.name: cupertino-unlock-fade
key.description: If true, unlocking in Cupertino mode plays a fade-out animation with a panel slide-in (automatically disabled when Power Saver mode is active). Disable for an instant unlock.

key.name: cupertino-crossfade-speed
key.description: Speed preset for the unlock crossfade animation. Values: 'slow', 'normal', 'fast'.

key.name: clock-animation
key.description: Animation applied to the date and time while opening the authentication prompt.

key.name: prompt-animation
key.description: Animation applied to the authentication prompt while it appears.

key.name: enable-unblank
key.description: Prevent the screen/monitor from blanking or turning off when locked.

key.name: unblank-on-ac-only
key.description: Only keep the screen on if the system is plugged into AC power.

key.name: esc-to-sleep
key.description: Pressing Escape on the lock screen immediately blanks/sleeps the display (or suspends the system if Keep Screen On is disabled).

key.name: prompt-vibrancy
key.description: Adaptive color and depth enhancements for the password field.

key.name: cursor-blink
key.description: Enable or disable text cursor blinking in the password entry field.

key.name: cupertino-lockscreen-message-enable
key.description: Show a custom message on the lock screen in Cupertino mode.

key.name: cupertino-lockscreen-message-text
key.description: The text to display on the lock screen in Cupertino mode.

key.name: lockscreen-wallpaper-enable
key.description: Use a custom image overlay as the lock screen background.

key.name: lockscreen-wallpaper-path
key.description: File path to the custom lock screen wallpaper image.

key.name: date-style
key.description: Choose between shortened and full date names on the lockscreen.

key.name: lockscreen-wallpaper-monitors
key.description: Map of monitor connector name (e.g. 'DP-1') to wallpaper path. Monitors without an entry use lockscreen-wallpaper-path. Paths may be images or GNOME slideshow XML files (time-of-day wallpapers).

key.name: clock-weight
key.description: Font weight of the lockscreen time.

key.name: clock-format
key.description: Use the system 12/24-hour setting, or override it on the lockscreen.

key.name: clock-tint
key.description: Tint the clock and date with a light shade of the wallpaper colour.

key.name: status-corner
key.description: Restyle the top-right status icons (battery, network, input source) on the lockscreen in Cupertino mode.

key.name: password-indicators
key.description: Show Caps Lock and keyboard layout indicators inside the password field instead of the Caps Lock text warning.

key.name: cupertino-system-actions
key.description: GDM DLC: show Suspend / Restart / Power Off buttons under the login user list and hide the Quick Settings power menu.

key.name: gdm-background-dimmer
key.description: GDM DLC: apply a subtle 15% darkening overlay to the login wallpaper for enhanced contrast.

key.name: general-disable-on-battery
key.summary: Whether to pause the video when on battery

key.name: general-action-on-blank
key.summary: What do to when the screen goes blank (0 - nothing, 1 - pause, 2 - restart video, 3 - next video)

key.name: general-action-on-end
key.summary: What to do when the video ends (0 - loop, 1 - pause, 2 - next video)

key.name: playlist-order
key.summary: Order of the videos in a folder (0 - sequential, 1 - shuffle, 2 - random)

key.name: playlist-start
key.summary: Which video to start with (0 - first, 1 - random, 2 - last played)

key.name: playlist-fade-enabled
key.summary: Whether to fade through black when switching videos

key.name: playlist-fade-duration
key.summary: Duration of the fade to and from black when switching videos (ms)

key.name: playlist-last-played
key.summary: Path of the last played video, used when starting with the last played one

key.name: general-mpris-enabled
key.summary: Whether the video can be controlled with media keys and other MPRIS clients

key.name: general-static-image-enabled
key.summary: Also play static images from the selected file or folder

key.name: background-photo-duration-seconds
key.summary: How long each static image is displayed

key.name: background-video-scaling-mode
key.summary: Background video scaling mode (0 - stretch, 1 - fit, 2 - cover)

key.name: background-video-use-videorate
key.summary: Whether to change FPS of the source (term videorate is a leftover from GStreamer)

key.name: prompt-pause-video
key.summary: Whether to pause the video on password prompt

key.name: prompt-grayscale
key.summary: Whether to grayscale the video on password prompt

key.name: prompt-change-blur
key.summary: Whether to change the blur value on password prompt

key.name: prompt-blur-radius
key.summary: Background video blur radius on password prompt

key.name: prompt-blur-brightness
key.summary: Background video brightness on password prompt

key.name: prompt-blur-anim-duration
key.summary: Background video blur change animation duration

key.name: mpv-profile
key.summary: MPV profile from external/mpv.conf (0 - quality, 1 - balanced, 2 - efficient)

key.name: mpv-custom-args
key.summary: Custom MPV arguments applied on top of the profile

key.name: live-enabled
key.description: Show the media file (video, GIF or picture) behind the lock screen.

key.name: dim-opacity
key.description: A light scrim, rgba(12,14,20), over the lock screen background under the clock, 0 to 85.

key.name: unlock-animation
key.description: slow-stop: the video slows to a stop and dissolves as the lock screen slides away; zoom: it lifts a little (1.03x) as it fades while the desktop settles from 1.03x into place; crossfade: a plain fade; none: at once.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: How long the lock and unlock animations take.

key.name: lock-entry-animation
key.description: The lock screen fades in from 1.04x to its size as the screen locks.

key.name: clock-style
key.description: sonoma-bold, cupertino-thin, digital, or custom (clock-font).

key.name: clock-font
key.description: A Pango font description (family, weight, size), used when clock-style is custom.

key.name: clock-color
key.description: A CSS colour for the time; empty: the theme's.

key.name: date-color
key.description: A CSS colour for the date; empty: the theme's.

key.name: clock-offset
key.description: Moves the clock and date up (negative) or down.

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Show notifications on the lock screen (frosted cards).

key.name: show-avatar
key.description: Show your picture above the password field.

key.name: hide-fingerprint-hint
key.description: No "or touch the fingerprint reader" line under the password field (the reader still works).

key.name: wallpaper-sync-mode
key.summary: Same media on the desktop and the lock screen
key.description: On: the lock screen plays the desktop's media (desktop-wallpaper-path); off: each has its own (the lock screen's is background-video-path).

key.name: desktop-wallpaper-path
key.description: A video or picture as the desktop background; empty: GNOME's own wallpaper.

key.name: desktop-hwaccel
key.description: vaapi: the graphics card; none: the processor.

key.name: desktop-audio-enabled
key.description: Off: the desktop video never opens an audio stream.

key.name: lockscreen-audio-enabled
key.description: Off: the lock screen video never opens an audio stream.

key.name: audio-auto-mute-on-other-media
key.summary: Mute the wallpaper while other media plays
key.description: Any other media player (MPRIS) playing mutes the wallpaper's sound until it stops.

key.name: topbar-enabled
key.summary: Finder, Places and the app indicator in the top bar
key.description: Off: this extension adds nothing to the top bar (MK Shell Engine's own, if on, show instead).

key.name: finder-logo-preset
key.description: fedora-blue (#51a2da), fedora-mono, mk, apple, custom (finder-custom-logo), none.

key.name: finder-custom-logo
key.description: An image file, used with the custom preset.

key.name: places-show-text
key.description: Off: the Places button is an icon only.

key.name: show-app-indicator
key.description: The focused app's icon and name in the top bar, with its window menu.

key.name: lock-media-controls
key.summary: Now Playing on the lock screen

key.name: lock-status-pill
key.summary: Battery and weather under the date

key.name: lock-weather
key.description: GNOME's weather (the location set in GNOME Weather or the clock).

key.name: compact-notifications
key.description: Narrow pills (380 px at most), three at a time and a count of the rest, with Clear.

key.name: lock-power-button
key.summary: Power button on the lock screen
key.description: Bottom right: Sleep, Hibernate, Restart, Shut Down.

key.name: zero-lag-lock
key.description: No heavy background blur (a light scrim instead; a single blur pass only while the password field shows), video in step with the screen's refresh rate.

key.name: pause-on-sleep
key.summary: Pause on sleep and screen off
key.description: The video pauses as the screen turns off or the computer sleeps, and plays again 250 ms after waking.

key.name: wake-to-password
key.description: Waking the computer shows the password field at once, not the clock.

key.name: show-hibernate
key.description: Hibernate in the Finder menu, Quick Settings' power menu and the lock screen's power button.

key.name: remap-sleep-to-hibernate
key.description: The Sleep buttons this extension adds hibernate instead.

key.name: finder-icon-size
key.description: 14 to 30 px; the top bar follows the slider live.

key.name: finder-logo-circular
key.description: A custom picture is cropped to a circle, like an avatar.

key.name: lock-clock-layout
key.description: sonoma-center (Sonoma Classic Center), sequoia-split (the clock left, the widgets right), vertical-stacked (Cyberpunk Vertical Stack: hours over minutes), corner-hud (Minimalist Corner HUD: small, top left), glass-framed (centred in a glass card); also sequoia-compact and minimal-left.

key.name: lock-glass-card
key.description: A frosted card behind the clock, the battery and weather pill and Now Playing.

key.name: lock-greeting
key.description: A line of your own (a greeting or a quote) above the password field; empty: none.

key.name: lock-clock-glow
key.description: A soft glow and drop shadow behind the time, 0 (none) to 100.

key.name: lock-date-format
key.description: full (Monday, November 9), short (Mon, Nov 9), numeric (09/11/2026, your locale's order), iso (2026-11-09).

key.name: wallpaper-background-play
key.description: The live wallpaper's sound plays on under your windows, fading out (400 ms) while any other app plays media and back in (350 ms) once that stops; off: heard only on the bare desktop.

key.name: weather-enabled
key.description: Open-Meteo for where your connection is (ipapi.co); off: no weather requests at all.

key.name: weather-cache-text
key.description: "24°C Clear Sky": shown at once after a boot, until the next reading.

key.name: weather-cache-city
key.summary: Where the last reading is for

key.name: weather-cache-place
key.summary: The last place found (JSON: lat, lon, city)

key.name: weather-cache-time
key.summary: When the last reading was taken (Unix time)
